description: Vietnamese L1 'đã-drop' transfer for REGULAR verbs: a past-time marker + a bare whitelisted regular verb gets the missing -ed (watch->watched, finish->finished, play->played). Complements the irregular rule (en-yesterday-irregular-beginner-past, buy/do/eat/go/have). Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on current main.
fp_risk_note: HIGH risk. Naive '-ed on a bare verb after a past marker' over-fires on: (1) habitual present with frequency adverbs ('Every day I cook', 'I always finish'); (2) verbs already in the past ('played' must not become 'playeded'); (3) irregulars that must not take -ed (handled by the irregular rule, not this one); (4) -y/-e spelling shifts. The v1 rule is whitelist-scoped, so a regular verb outside the whitelist ('cook' today) abstains. The negative cases lock surfaces (1)-(4) plus the whitelist boundary.

positive.expectedCorrection: Last night she watched a movie.

positive.notes: Lane A boundary: 'yesterday' + 'walk' -> 'walked'. Verified firing on the live engine.

positive.expectedCorrection: Two days ago we visited grandma.
positive.notes: Lane A boundary: '<n> days ago' + 'visit' -> 'visited'. Verified firing on the live engine.

negative.notes: FP-stress (habitual present): frequency 'every day', no past marker; must not add -ed. Verified abstaining.
FP-stress (already past): 'played' must not double to 'playeded'. Verified abstaining.
FP-stress (whitelist boundary): past marker present but 'cook' is outside the v1 regular-verb whitelist, so the rule abstains rather than guess. Verified abstaining.
FP-stress (frequency adverb, no marker): 'always' habitual with whitelisted 'finish' but no past marker; must not fire. Verified abstaining.

negative.expectedCorrection: Did you walk to school yesterday?
negative.notes: Lane A over-fire guard (do-support question): 'did … walk' is already past via the auxiliary; bare 'walk' must NOT get -ed. Verified abstaining.
Lane A over-fire guard (negated did): 'did not walk' carries past in the auxiliary; 'walk' must stay bare. Verified abstaining.

negative.notes: Lane A over-fire guard (habitual present): 'every day', no past marker; whitelisted 'walk' must not fire. Verified abstaining.
Lane A over-fire guard (already past): 'walked' must not double to 'walkeded'. Verified abstaining.
